**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/davidaayers/opencode-go-usage-plugin/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3

Documentation-only patch release.

- Align README headings and installation wording with the other OpenCode TUI plugins.

First stable release.

- Three plan gauges (5h / wk / mo) in the session sidebar, with percent + reset countdown beneath each
- Proximity colors: `success` <50% → `accent` 50–74% → `warning` 75–89% → `error` ≥90% / rate-limited
- Compact `Go month N%` line in the prompt bar when the sidebar is hidden
- Uses the official `GET /zen/go/v1/usage` API — zero config, no dashboard scraping

**Install**

```sh
opencode plugin --global @davidaayers/opencode-go-usage-plugin
```
